description: Defines a class 'DocStore_DocumentLoaders' implementing data loading from document stores, including methods to list stores and initialize document retrieval, with integration to a database via TypeORM and document processing.

classes.name: DocStore_DocumentLoaders
classes.description: A class for loading documents from pre-configured document stores, providing methods to list available stores and initialize document retrieval.

methods.name: loadMethods.listStores
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a list of document stores with status 'SYNC' from the database.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes document loading by fetching chunks from the database and returning either document objects or concatenated text.
